forecast-period.text: A high pressure ridge will move across the north of the state on Wednesday and Thursday and a cold front will slip across the southeast of SA early Thursday. The ridge will move eastwards early Friday then another trough will move over SA during the day followed by a cold front early Saturday. Another high pressure ridge will move across during Sunday ahead of a low pressure system expected to develop in the far west later in the day.
Wind and wave forecasts are averages. Wind gusts can be 40 per cent stronger than the forecast, and stronger still in squalls and thunderstorms. Maximum waves can be twice the forecast height.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones. Marine forecasts are also available on VHF and HF radio. View the radio schedule on www.bom.gov.au/marine
Check the latest Coastal Waters Forecasts for information on wind, wave and weather conditions for neighbouring coastal zones.

area.description: Lower South East Coast: Cape Jaffa to SA-VIC Border

forecast-period.warning-summary: Strong Wind Warning for Wednesday for Lower South East Coast
forecast-period.text: Westerly 15 to 25 knots turning northwesterly 20 to 25 knots in the middle of the day. Winds reaching up to 30 knots in the evening.
Southwesterly 3 metres, increasing to 3 to 4 metres around midday, then tending west to southwesterly 4 metres later in the evening.

forecast-period.warning-summary: Strong Wind Warning for Thursday for Lower South East Coast
forecast-period.text: Northwesterly 20 to 25 knots, reaching up to 30 knots during the morning and early afternoon. Winds turning westerly 15 to 25 knots before dawn.
2 to 3 metres, decreasing to 1 to 2 metres by early evening.
Westerly 4 to 5 metres, tending southwesterly 5 to 6 metres during the afternoon.
West to northwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending north to northwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the morning.
1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore.
Cloudy. 90% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the evening.
